subtitle: Out Cebu · Vietnam Airlines
overview: A no-shopping Beijing tour flying Cebu to Beijing via Hanoi on Vietnam Airlines, staying four nights in 4-star hotels. See the Summer Palace, Juyongguan Great Wall, Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, enjoy an acrobat show and an upgraded Peking duck dinner, then spend a full day at Universal Studios Beijing.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 20–24 2027 to Jun 23–27 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Summer Palace: Beijing's imperial lakeside garden, with temples, pavilions and a long covered corridor.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-preserved section of the Great Wall in a mountain pass north of Beijing.
placeDesc.Water Cube: The swimming venue of the 2008 Olympics, seen with a photo stop.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium, the main stadium of the 2008 Olympics, seen with a photo stop.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: The huge central square of Beijing, beside the entrance to the Forbidden City.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of China's Ming and Qing emperors, in the centre of Beijing.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Beijing: A full-day theme park visit with round-trip transfer and one-day ticket included.
